about: Overworld maps link through map gates at their edges. Realm doors on overworld maps open a realm world (5 linked maps); its first map has the return portal. Dungeons start at the moss gate (sp-gate) on Mill Plains.

regions.name: Mossvale · the overworld
regions.note: the main world: a town and fields around it; realm doors lead to the 6 realm worlds

regions.name: Hollowroot · realm world
regions.monsters: slimes, forest sprites, boars, a treant boss

regions.name: Emberdeep · realm world
regions.monsters: ember imps, cinder beetles, a magma golem boss

regions.name: The Rotting Maw · realm world
regions.monsters: bog ghouls, spiders, a swamp hag boss

regions.name: Rimefang · realm world
regions.monsters: frost wolves, ice elementals, a yeti boss

regions.name: Temple of the Sun Wyrm · realm world
regions.monsters: scorpions, mummies, a sun wyrm boss

regions.name: The Shattered Vault · realm world
regions.monsters: stone sentinels, wraiths, a rune titan boss
